data.description:
## What
Run one-shot migration: scan repo for # REVIEW-DEFENSE: inline comments, bind to tickets, delete from files. Remove reviewer-base.md and review-fix-dispatch.md REVIEW-DEFENSE sections.

## Steps
1. Search files for # REVIEW-DEFENSE: pattern: grep -rl '# REVIEW-DEFENSE:' plugins/dso/
2. For each file: extract the comment, identify the owning story/task ticket (most-recent epic story touching that file path)
3. If owning ticket found: post as DEFENSE_RECORD: comment via .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment
4. If no ticket found (UNBOUND): collect into a summary comment on the epic (dbbc-cf67)
5. Delete the inline comments from each file
6. Remove REVIEW-DEFENSE Evaluation section from plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
7. Remove 'Defend findings' section from plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -r '# REVIEW-DEFENSE:' plugins/dso/ -> 0 results
- reviewer-base.md no longer contains REVIEW-DEFENSE section
- review-fix-dispatch.md no longer contains 'Defend findings' section
- make lint passes
data.title: UPDATE: migrate legacy # REVIEW-DEFENSE: inline comments to tracker; remove REVIEW-DEFENSE doc sections
